# 6 · Entity Framework Migrations

Entity Framework Core keeps the Postgres schema in sync with your C# models.

## 6.1 Initial Database Creation

Run once per environment:

```bash
dotnet ef database update --project src/Pedalogical.Data
```

## 6.2 Adding a Migration (Model Change)

```bash
dotnet ef migrations add <Feature>_<DateUTC>   --project src/Pedalogical.Data   --startup-project src/Pedalogical.Api
dotnet ef database update --project src/Pedalogical.Data
```

### Naming Convention

```
<Verb><Entity><WhatChanged>_<yyyymmddHHMM>
```

Examples:

* `AddStudentEmail_202507052130`
* `RenameCourseTable_20250710`

## 6.3 Undo the Last Migration

```bash
dotnet ef migrations remove --project src/Pedalogical.Data
```

## 6.4 Migrate to a Specific Version

```bash
dotnet ef database update 202507052130 --project src/Pedalogical.Data
```

## 6.5 Refreshing the Database (nuke & pave)

```bash
dropdb pedalogical           # native
createdb pedalogical
dotnet ef database update
```

---

### Troubleshooting

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| `Build failed` | Ensure the solution builds before running `dotnet ef`. |
| `No migrations were applied` | You already ran them — verify with `select * from __EFMigrationsHistory;`. |

---

🎉 *You now have a fully functioning Pedalogical dev environment!*
